title.narrative: Tax Administrations: capacity development, phase 2, Swedish Tax Authority

description.narrative: Tax Administrations in BiH have improved capacity and have started to transform into modern, trustworthy and helpful tax administrations. To achieve the objectives, there are some assumptions made about the resources from the BiH Tax Administrations: Relevant counterparts for the STA are available There is enough time allocated for the staff from the BiH Tax Administrations to attend missions/workshops and to do the work needed in between missions. Support and relevant decisions made by top and middle management when needed Close cooperation between the BiH Tax Administrations and STA staff

Insatsen är den andra fasen i ett projekt som Skatteverket genomför tillsammans med skattemyndigheter och finansministerier i Bosninen-Hercegovina (BiH). Den första fasen genomfördes 2017-2021. Projektets mål är att stärka kapaciteten inom de deltagande institutionerna för att bidra till moderna, pålitliga och hjälpsamma skattemyndigheter i BiH. I förlängningen syftar projektet till att förbereda BiH på reformer inom skattesystemet och dess institutioner för att landet ska närma EU-medlemskap. Projektet arbetar inom en rad olika områden där experter från svenska Skatteverket utbildar och utbyter erfarenheter med kollegor från motsvarande bosniska myndigheter. En viktig aspekt av projektet handlar om att skapa kontaktytor mellan myndigheterna och institutionerna i BiH för att de ska utbyta information och samarbeta mer och bättre. Det behövs för att samordna skattesystemen i landet, vilket är en förutsättning för EU-medlemskap. De områden som projetket arbetar med handlar om allt från att förbättra service och attityder gentemot brukare/skattebetalare till mer tekniska områden som förifyllda deklarationer och internationellt samarbete på skatteområdet.

The contribution is the second phase in a project that the Swedish Tax Agency (STA) is implementing together with the tax authorities and finance ministries in Bosnia-Herzegovina (BiH). The first phase was completed in 2017-2021. The overall objective of the project is to strengthen the capacity within the participating institutions to contribute to modern, trustworthy and helpful tax administrations in BiH. In the long run, the project aims to prepare BiH for reforms within the tax system and its institutions in order for the country to approach EU membership. The project works in a number of different areas where experts from STA train and exchange experiences with colleagues from corresponding BiH authorities. An important aspect of the project is creating contacts between authorities and institutions in BiH in order for them to exchange information and collaborate more and better. This is crucial to harmonize the tax systems in the country, which is a prerequisite for EU membership. The areas within the project works are ranging from improving service and attitudes towards taxpayers to more technical areas such as pre-filled declarations and international cooperation in the area of taxation.

Within the change the mindset component, the objective is defined as follows: The project is building capacity for change in values. A transformation in values in the long run can increase the trust from taxpayers that contribute to increased revenue. It is assessed that activities have been implemented as planned. However some additional work is identified during the exit workshop that should be in focus of the prolongation, i.e. to provide a framework for the implementation of a Human Resource Strategy. The mindset is definitely positively changed. Through the project, a platform has been created for the various authorities to build networks between each other. There is now a regular exchange of information (e.g. on control activities) and knowledge with each other. Furthermore, this has also led to agreements being signed between each other, e.g. regarding certain training and operational collaboration. The component of improved service, has a relation to the perception of service both by citizens and businesses. The project has regularly conducted surveys (using Swedish model) and these form the basis of this component. Surveys constantly show the need to develop new digital services. The work on developing new training programs for auditors has also resulted in the use of the new knowledge/method support and experience of how to work in the development of training in other areas. For example, it is a question of which pedagogical tools have the best effect for a particular education. And how to plan, implement and follow up a training course. The management of the agencies has an increased understanding and insight and is more active in managing and supporting control activities based on international standards. E.g. mapping which industries are most at risk (through pilot checks) so that it is possible to focus resources where the problems are greatest. Entity tax administrations have so far concentrated their work on risk management in special units in order to be able to work in a more structured way. Based on previous surveys, it appears that there is a need among taxpayers to receive more digital services. The agencies have gained knowledge of how to work with the development of services and the knowledge is translated into prioritising areas for future development. The authorities regularly conduct customer surveys (2018, 2020 and 2023 with the support of the project). The agencies are continuously working to develop services that support taxpayers based on the needs and feedback that emerge from the surveys. The authorities have set up a single point of entry at the National Ministry of Finance to send and receive information exchange on request in accordance with OECD standards.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
